RG.name: Rahmah
RG.look: a bright, curious Minangkabau girl of about eight with warm medium-brown skin and dark eyes, in a long loose baju kurung tunic of deep green over a long batik sarong, and a white headscarf that covers all her hair, her forehead and her neck

RY.name: Rahmah
RY.look: a determined, kind Minangkabau woman of about twenty-five with warm medium-brown skin and dark eyes, in a long loose baju kurung tunic of deep green over a long batik sarong, and a white headscarf that covers all her hair, her forehead and her neck

RO.name: Rahmah
RO.look: a dignified, kind Minangkabau woman of about fifty-five with warm medium-brown skin, a few lines on her face and dark eyes, in a long loose baju kurung tunic of deep green over a long batik sarong, and a white headscarf that covers all her hair, her forehead and her neck; not a single hair shows at her forehead
